about: Copy this to docs/plan.json and make it the game's plan: every world, enemy, item, boss, sound, tune, picture and story beat. Then run node scripts/plan.js. npm test lists what is still missing (todo); npm run test:full fails until all of it is real.

enemies.name: slime
enemies.does: walks, turns at walls and ledges; stomp it

enemies.name: bat
enemies.does: flies in a wave; stomp it

items.name: gem
items.does: 500 points; three hidden in every level

items.name: feather
items.does: double jump for the rest of the level

bosses.name: golem
bosses.does: three hits; charges, then rests; guards the last exit
